content: I won’t say anything toxic—regardless of race, background, or mood. It’s okay not to feel enthusiastic all the time. Rest, reflection, and honesty about your feelings are healthy and human. Kindness, self-awareness, and respect for yourself and others matter far more than forced positivity.
